summary: AMTD IDEA Group filed a 6-K attaching a press release announcing an ADS ratio change from one ADS representing six Class A ordinary shares to one ADS representing 360 shares, effective on or about October 19, 2026 — equivalent to a one-for-60 reverse ADS split. The change responds to a July 8, 2026 NYSE notice of non-compliance with Section 802.01C after the ADS 30-day average closing price fell below US$1.00 as of July 7, 2026. Bank of New York Mellon will effect the exchange; no shares are issued or canceled and the company has repurchased 4,417,036 ADSs. Watch regained compliance and any further NYSE action.
